name: Tertiary SmartRider (WA)
summary: Discounted Transperth fares for full-time students at WA universities and TAFE.
key: The card costs $10, including $5 of credit, at most institutions.
who: Full-time students at a Western Australian university or TAFE college.
Full-time is set by your institution. For example, 24 credit points at UWA or 12 contact hours a week at Notre Dame.
how: Curtin, ECU, Murdoch, UWA and TAFE: get a SmartRider and register it through your institution's portal or form, then tag on and off to activate the concession.
Notre Dame and other colleges: fill in the Tertiary SmartRider application, have Student Administration sign it, and take it to a Transperth sales outlet.
need: A second photo ID, such as a driver's licence. Your student ID doesn't count as proof of full-time study.
catches: Part-time and correspondence students can't apply, and neither can students from interstate or overseas institutions.
At Notre Dame and other colleges the concession expires on 31 March of the next year, so reapply before then.
Transperth doesn't state the size of the discount, so no figure is shown.
